sentences.pt: Juliana mora em um prédio antigo no centro de Curitiba.
sentences.en: Juliana lives in an old building in downtown Curitiba.

sentences.pt: Ao lado do apartamento dela mora Dona Lúcia, uma senhora de oitenta anos.
sentences.en: Next to her apartment lives Dona Lúcia, an eighty-year-old lady.

sentences.pt: Dona Lúcia mora sozinha, mas está sempre alegre.
sentences.en: Dona Lúcia lives alone, but she is always cheerful.

sentences.pt: Toda manhã, ela conversa com Juliana na escada.
sentences.en: Every morning, she chats with Juliana on the stairs.

sentences.pt: Ontem, Juliana não viu a vizinha.
sentences.en: Yesterday, Juliana didn't see her neighbor.

sentences.pt: Ela chamou Dona Lúcia na porta, mas ninguém respondeu.
sentences.en: She called Dona Lúcia at the door, but nobody answered.

sentences.pt: Juliana ficou preocupada e ligou para o filho dela.
sentences.en: Juliana got worried and called her son.

sentences.pt: O filho explicou que a mãe estava com gripe e estava descansando.
sentences.en: The son explained that his mother had the flu and was resting.

sentences.pt: Então Juliana decidiu fazer uma sopa para ela.
sentences.en: So Juliana decided to make a soup for her.

sentences.pt: Ela foi ao mercado e comprou batatas, cenouras e frango.
sentences.en: She went to the market and bought potatoes, carrots and chicken.

sentences.pt: Em casa, ela cozinhou a sopa durante quase uma hora.
sentences.en: At home, she cooked the soup for almost an hour.

sentences.pt: Depois, levou a panela quente até a porta da vizinha.
sentences.en: Then she took the hot pot to the neighbor's door.

sentences.pt: Desta vez, Dona Lúcia abriu a porta.
sentences.en: This time, Dona Lúcia opened the door.

sentences.pt: Ela estava cansada, mas ficou muito feliz.
sentences.en: She was tired, but she was very happy.

sentences.pt: — Você fez isso para mim? — ela perguntou.
sentences.en: "You made this for me?" she asked.

sentences.pt: — Claro! A senhora sempre me ajuda — respondeu Juliana.
sentences.en: "Of course! You always help me," Juliana answered.

sentences.pt: As duas tomaram a sopa na cozinha e conversaram muito.
sentences.en: The two of them had the soup in the kitchen and talked a lot.

sentences.pt: Uma semana depois, Dona Lúcia já estava melhor.
sentences.en: A week later, Dona Lúcia was already better.

sentences.pt: Ela fez um bolo de chocolate e levou para Juliana.
sentences.en: She made a chocolate cake and took it to Juliana.

sentences.pt: Agora, além de vizinhas, elas são amigas.
sentences.en: Now, besides being neighbors, they are friends.

questions.q: Por que Dona Lúcia não respondeu?
O que Dona Lúcia fez para Juliana?
questions.qEn: What did Dona Lúcia make for Juliana?

sentences.pt: Gustavo acordou atrasado na segunda-feira.
sentences.en: Gustavo woke up late on Monday.

sentences.pt: Ele tomou um banho rápido, colocou a roupa e pegou a mochila.
sentences.en: He took a quick shower, put on his clothes and grabbed his backpack.

sentences.pt: Mas, quando foi abrir a porta, não encontrou as chaves.
sentences.en: But when he went to open the door, he didn't find the keys.

sentences.pt: Ele sempre deixa as chaves em cima da mesa da sala.
sentences.en: He always leaves the keys on the living room table.

sentences.pt: Mas elas não estavam lá.
sentences.en: But they weren't there.

sentences.pt: Ele procurou embaixo do sofá, atrás da televisão e até dentro da geladeira.
sentences.en: He looked under the sofa, behind the TV and even inside the fridge.

sentences.pt: Nada.
sentences.en: Nothing.

sentences.pt: Gustavo ficou nervoso, porque tinha uma reunião às nove horas.
sentences.en: Gustavo got nervous, because he had a meeting at nine o'clock.

sentences.pt: Então ele ligou para a namorada, Aline.
sentences.en: So he called his girlfriend, Aline.

sentences.pt: — Aline, você viu as minhas chaves? — perguntou ele.
sentences.en: "Aline, have you seen my keys?" he asked.

sentences.pt: — Não vi. Você olhou na mochila? — ela respondeu.
sentences.en: "I didn't see them. Did you look in the backpack?" she answered.

sentences.pt: Ele abriu a mochila, mas só encontrou um caderno, uma caneta e uma banana.
sentences.en: He opened the backpack, but only found a notebook, a pen and a banana.

sentences.pt: Já eram oito e meia.
sentences.en: It was already half past eight.

sentences.pt: Nesse momento, o gato pulou do sofá.
sentences.en: At that moment, the cat jumped off the sofa.

sentences.pt: Embaixo do gato, estavam as chaves!
sentences.en: Under the cat were the keys!

sentences.pt: O gato estava dormindo sobre elas a manhã toda.
sentences.en: The cat had been sleeping on them all morning.

sentences.pt: Gustavo riu, pegou as chaves e saiu correndo.
sentences.en: Gustavo laughed, grabbed the keys and ran out.

sentences.pt: Ele chegou ao escritório às nove horas, a tempo para a reunião.
sentences.en: He got to the office at nine o'clock, in time for the meeting.

sentences.pt: À noite, ele decidiu: agora as chaves vão ficar sempre perto da porta.
sentences.en: In the evening, he decided: from now on the keys will always stay near the door.

questions.q: Onde Gustavo sempre deixa as chaves?
questions.qEn: Where does Gustavo always leave the keys?
options: Em cima da mesa da sala

questions.q: A que horas era a reunião?
